routine.name: Unreplied Emails Digest
routine.description: Every morning, searches the inbox for emails from other people that the owner has not replied to and that have been sitting for more than a chosen number of days. Uses a judgment to skip automated/notification emails and anything that doesn't actually need a reply, then sends a concise list to the chosen destinations. Sends nothing when no email qualifies.

judgments.needs_reply: Does this email actually need a reply from the owner (it asks a question, requests an action, or expects a response), as opposed to being automated, a notification, a newsletter, or purely informational?

params.name: min_days
params.label: Minimum days waiting
params.help: Only include emails waiting longer than this many days

params.name: lookback_days
params.label: Inbox search window (days)
params.help: How far back to search the inbox for candidate emails
